notes.title: New Level! The Hatchery
notes.content:
Also contains 2 new Dinosaur enemies! The Allosaurus and the Allosaurus Mother
This new level takes you to one of the secret breeding facilities on the Island. 

Inspired by community feedback, this update contains:


 A new level added to the main story
 The Allosaurus New Dinosaur Enemy
 Egg nests to destroy
 New hidden tapes with audio logs
 Dinosaur Museum

notes.title: Update 0.2 Is Here
notes.content:
Another update is here! This one adds some things I thought would make the gameplay more fun like more guns and ammo drops.

Added Sniper / Shotgun to Level 3
More ammo drops on Levels 2 and 5
Dinosaur Ai adjusted very slightly

notes.title: Update .1 Is Here!
notes.content:
This update fixes bugs and glitches pointed out by the community. 


Fixed player getting stuck in a wall on 1st level
Adjusted Triceratops walking speed and Collision box staying behind when dead
Added Assault Rifle to Level 2 (Radio Room)
More Ammo Drops on Last Level
